frozen_plan.candidate_change: Add Solver-owned minimize_stack and minimize_touched; alias and clear both on every redundant_literal entry. No changed traversal, bitmap cleanup, decisions, proof generation, budgets, or native ABI.

checking.SAT: Full ordered model independently checked in a separate Python process against every original admitted clause; also requires valid prefix.
checking.metadata_conflicts: Any checked SAT/UNSAT conflict with declared label remains failure for adjudication.
checking.prefix: Strict in-range DRUP syntax; exit1 plus sole exact s DERIVATION and zero empty clauses, with no spawn error or timeout. Prefix validation is not an UNSAT verdict.
checking.refutation: Status20 requires exactly one empty proof row and exit0 plus sole exact s VERIFIED.

claim_boundary: No new solved-case or G0 claim from checked UNKNOWN prefixes.
No full-corpus or endpoint speedup, ranking, hidden evaluation or independent replication claim.
No change to historical failure/timeout outcomes or frozen packing study.
Candidate eligibility alone does not adopt source.

eligibility.disqualifying_outcomes: Any invalid/incomplete/resource/checker/admission/artifact failure; any trace or cross-repeat mismatch; any failed CPU, individual-median or memory gate.
eligibility.required_unique_cartesian_population: 10 declared case IDs times3repeat indices; no missing or duplicate pair

frozen_plan.equivalence: All30pairs must match ordered complete DRUP bytes, model bytes, all eight native counters/status and deterministic terminal invariant receipt fields exactly; matching is not a complete decision/event trace or full internal-array state identity. Each variant must also match its own corresponding receipts across all3repeats.
frozen_plan.evidence_retention: Complete raw models, DRUP prefixes, terminal/timing/memory receipts, process/checker logs, input/source/build hashes and all failed controls remain retained. No on-the-fly evidence deletion or replacement. Prior pre-freeze build/control revisions remain in pre-review directories.
frozen_plan.hypothesis: Repeated vector allocation in redundant_literal has avoidable CPU cost; retaining capacity should preserve every common logical observation.

memory.eligibility_metric: Linux /proc/self/status VmHWM sampled inside execed harness after proof/model output and terminal invariant audit; peak includes parsing/setup/solve/output/audit, not solve-only.
memory.limit_scope: 4096MiB RLIMIT_AS per process;64MiB RLIMIT_FSIZE per output file; no aggregate cgroup or security isolation.
memory.secondary_metric: wait4 peak_rss_kib retained; may include Python supervisor fork/preexec highwater, so not used for eligibility.

frozen_plan.purpose: Measure whether reusing two minimization scratch vectors reduces CPU for exactly matched learned-prefix/model/counter/terminal-receipt work on all ten original failed cases.
frozen_plan.schedule: Sequential fresh process groups; repeat0/1/2 each visits all ten cases in original order. Baseline then candidate when(repeat+case_index) is even, otherwise candidate then baseline:15AB and15BA. Each cell includes its checks before the next solver starts.
frozen_plan.selection: All ten original invalid-model cases, in existing native_derivation_audit_20261022.json frozen inventory order; no exclusions or replacements.

timing.cpu_clock_contract: Nonnegative finite timer, integral tick count/frequency, ticks/frequency agrees with recorded CPU seconds; solve CPU no more than process CPU plus0.02seconds.
timing.primary_metric: std::clock process CPU seconds immediately around Solver::solve; input parsing, clause installation, heap initialization, serialization, terminal audit and external checking excluded equally.
timing.process_timeout: timed_out OR elapsed_seconds strictly greater than60 rejects; exact60 boundary accepted, independently of supervisor polling.
timing.secondary_metrics: Whole harness process user/system CPU and wall duration from pinned campaign.run_process; solve wall duration from steady_clock.

limitations: Project-owned shared-host measurements are not outside-team replication.
Fixed-conflict solve CPU excludes input setup, proof serialization and independent checking; whole-process receipts are retained separately.
Exact terminal receipts summarize checked invariants; they are not snapshots of every internal array.
Local raw-evidence retention is not permanent public publication.
No new solved-count, competitive-rank, hidden-set, G0 or 100/100 claim follows from this study.
payload_reconstruction: For each payload, base64-decode data then zlib.decompress; require exact bytes and SHA-256 before writing to the relative path in a fresh destination. Reject absolute paths and any path containing .. . Executables and benchmark input/proof bytes are retained separately; their identities and build commands are pinned, not embedded here.
scope: New exposed fixed-work candidate experiment; original packing studies and historical scores unchanged.
